experiment: CSE805 supervised segmentation error prediction v1

features.alignment: Own image and own semantic GT only, no normal-reference pixel correspondence
features.categorical: predicted semantic class; 19 Cityscapes train IDs, 0 through 18
features.invIds: Perceptual ambiguity mask, not primary semantic-validity mask and never a predictor feature
features.label: 1[predicted_trainId != semantic_GT_trainId]
features.margin: largest probability minus second largest probability
features.prediction: argmax of unscaled float32 interpolated logits; lowest class index for exact ties
features.probability: raw float32 softmax(z), T=1; finite, positive-normalized probabilities verified
features.resize: float32 bilinear native logits to label/image resolution, align_corners=False, before raw softmax
features.validity: GT in 0..18; exclude 255; other GT IDs are a hard data error

group_ambiguity: Filename chapter-family proxy, not verified independent camera/date/session/drive/route
group_rule: fullmatch (?:GOPR|GP[0-9]{2})([0-9]{4}); gopro_ + four-digit suffix; exact prefix must equal parent directory

inner.assignment: Within outer train only: groups sorted by decreasing image count then group ID; greedily assign to fold with fewest same-weather images, then total images, then fold index
inner.both_error_classes_required: Require both labels in each training/development/evaluation population; fail and disclose unsupported metrics instead of fabricating scores
inner.missing_weather: Some inner dev folds omit a weather because rain/night each have only three groups before outer holdout
inner.selection: Arithmetic mean of three inner-dev AP values, each computed with N_valid_image/sample_count weights; ties within 1e-12 select smaller C

interpretation.claim_limits: No new segmentation backbone, no changed original segmentation mIoU, no superiority before measured evidence
interpretation.class_ablation: lr3_class minus lr3 for same held-out family and pixels
interpretation.group_uncertainty: Descriptive paired family deltas, wins/ties/losses, range and leave-one-family-out sensitivity of mean; 17 conservative proxies, not proven independent sessions
interpretation.historical_exploration: Existing data were used in earlier COMP895 experiments; not pristine confirmatory test data
interpretation.pooled_caution: Pooled cross-fitted scores combine different fold-specific models; diagnostic, not performance of one deployed model
interpretation.primary_endpoint: Mean paired outer-family difference in retrospective80 accepted error: each learned method minus raw MSP; negative is better; also compare raw entropy
interpretation.reporting: Every family, each weather, pooled out-of-fold histograms, unsuccessful methods, and selection/runtime costs
interpretation.significance: No pixel-IID significance tests or confidence intervals; no unsupported population-wide significance claim

method_definition.class_balance: No class-balanced sampling, no class weights; preserve pixel prevalence through inclusion weights
method_definition.lr3: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression on three continuous features
method_definition.lr3_class: StandardScaler continuous features plus predicted-class one-hot in sklearn preprocessing pipeline, then LogisticRegression
method_definition.preprocessing: Fit scaler/encoder inside each inner-training or final outer-training sklearn pipeline only
method_definition.raw_entropy: normalized predictive entropy; greater means more likely error

metrics.aurc: Histogram grouped-bin risk-coverage approximation; same rule for every method
metrics.auroc: Histogram approximation, tied-bin positive/negative pairs receive half credit
metrics.bin_assignment: min(floor(clipped_score*10000),9999); zero in first bin and one in last bin
metrics.prevalence: Exact error pixels / exact valid pixels
metrics.primary_pixels: Identical complete semantic-valid pixels for all four methods
metrics.qa: Compare histogram metrics against exact sklearn/sorted metrics on synthetic cases and retained shared per-image QA sample; disclose discrepancies
metrics.retrospective80: Nearest attainable whole-bin cumulative coverage to 0.8, ties choose lower coverage; report actual coverage and error; diagnostic only, never deployment threshold
metrics.streaming: 10,000 fixed equal-width score histogram bins over [0,1] per method; exact population/error and threshold counts; scores regenerated from native logits in image chunks
metrics.training_threshold: Exact held-out accepted and error counts using training-only threshold

outer.method: leave one conservative recording proxy group out

preservation.legacy_files: Read-only; no writes to original data, stage1-stage5, or results
preservation.new_artifacts: All new code, metadata, features, models, logs, and reports inside this extension directory

primary_population: All 1600 official adverse train images; 400 per weather

sampling.evaluation: Primary metrics use every valid full-resolution pixel; QA sample is not the primary estimate
sampling.method: Uniform semantic-valid pixels without replacement; deterministic image-ID SHA256 and seed; no error/class stratification
sampling.weight: N_valid_image / sampled_count; normalize weights to mean 1 for fitting only

supplemental_validation: 406 official val images inventoried separately; excluded from all primary fits, tuning, and evaluation

threshold.limitation: Training-score quantile is optimistic in-sample and does not guarantee 80% unseen-group coverage; ties may overshoot
threshold.record: threshold, achieved weighted training-sample coverage, exact outer accepted counts/errors/coverage
threshold.selection: For each method and outer fold, weighted 80% quantile of final outer-training sample scores; accept score <= threshold
